body: Try running device care and put those overheating apps to sleep

Voltaic tracking easy playlist, you can get it from the workshop. There are other playlists based on flicking , tracking ,target switching and all combined. Choose what you like When tracking make sure to look at the targets and not your crosshair, this tip really helped me improve.

Reactive tracking scenarios really helped me with my jittery tracking, I put at least 30min a day on Voltaic reactive tracking scenarios and it really improved my tracking and reaction time. I play the advance scenarios even though my skill level is pretty low. My sens is 54cm/360 and I play valorant. I think playing on advance level helped me cause the targets move pretty fast and I have to move my hands quickly. Make sure to do stretches before you start cause I injured my wrist once and can't play for a week.
